Guard against reading a between-unit slope as a within-unit one

Source: R/guards.R
pollin_guard_ecological.Rd

An exposure slope estimated across sites (between units) is an ecological association: it need not hold for plants within a site, where unit-level confounders are held fixed. This guard splits the exposure into its between-unit and within-unit parts with pollin_within_between() and fits response ~ within + between by least squares, reporting the pooled, within-unit and between-unit slopes. It warns when

Usage

pollin_guard_ecological(
  x,
  exposure,
  response = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05
)

Arguments

x

A data frame, or a pollin_data() object.

exposure

Name of the numeric exposure column (for example insect abundance).

response

Name of the numeric response column. With a pollin_data() object it may be left NULL when one response is declared.

unit

The unit column(s) the exposure is split by. Required for a data frame (several columns are combined); with a pollin_data() object, one of the unit columns, taken within its outer units, and NULL (the default) uses the outermost unit.

alpha

Significance level for the third check.

Value

An object of class pollin_ecological: a list holding the slope table slopes (component, slope, standard error, p-value), the number of units n_units, the flags raised (a character vector, empty when none) and the column names used.

Details

  • the exposure does not vary within units, so only the between-unit slope exists;

  • only the between-unit slope is distinguishable from zero at alpha;

  • the within-unit and between-unit slopes are both distinguishable from zero at alpha and disagree in sign.

The guard works on the rows given; subset to one arm beforehand when the slope of interest is within that arm.

See also

pollin_moderation() for the model-based within/between split.

Examples

set.seed(1)
site <- rep(sprintf("s%02d", 1:10), each = 8)
site_bees <- rep(rnorm(10, 10, 3), each = 8)
bees <- site_bees + rnorm(80)
# Sites with more bees yield more, but plants within a site do not respond
pods <- 20 + 2 * site_bees + rnorm(80, 0, 2)
df <- data.frame(pods = pods, bees = bees, Site = site)
pollin_guard_ecological(df, "bees", "pods", unit = "Site")
#> Warning: Only the between-unit slope is distinguishable from zero (p = 3.4e-31 between, 0.0518 within); the association is between units, not within them.
#> <pollin_ecological>  pods ~ bees split by Site (10 units)
#>  component   slope std.error   p.value
#>     pooled  1.5788   0.13100 1.715e-19
#>     within -0.4887   0.24734 5.178e-02
#>    between  1.9108   0.09913 3.404e-31
#>   ! Only the between-unit slope is distinguishable from zero (p = 3.4e-31 between, 0.0518 within); the association is between units, not within them.
